text: Every parent in our neighborhood sends their kids to Westlake Academy. It is the school that families in this area choose, and there is a reason for that. When you see that level of consensus among educated, involved parents who have done their research, it tells you something. Going against that collective judgment and choosing a different school would be an unusual decision that most families in our community would find hard to understand.
